lease 192.0.2.10 {
  starts 3 2026/10/21 08:00:00;
  ends 3 2026/10/21 20:00:00;

  client-hostname "lab-laptop";
}
lease 192.0.2.11 {
  starts 3 2026/10/21 09:30:00;
  ends never;
  hardware ethernet 28:6F:B9:00:00:02;
  binding state active;
}
lease 192.0.2.12 {
  ends 4 2026/10/22 10:00:00;
  hardware ethernet 00-00-0C-11-22-33;
  option agent.circuit-id "port-7";
}
